C1827.title: Zhao et al. Prove AI-Generated Image Invisible Watermarks Can Be Universally Removed by Generative Models
C1827.summary: At NeurIPS 2024, Zhao Xuandong et al. proved that mainstream invisible watermarks on AI-generated images can be universally removed by generative models. The attack family first adds noise to the watermarked image to destroy the watermark signal, then recovers visual fidelity through denoising/regeneration, successfully removing four pixel-level watermark schemes including Tree-Ring and Stable Signature, revealing that watermarks relying on generative latent spaces are not a reliable guarantee of provenance, and open-sourced WatermarkAttacker for reproduction.
